response.sql: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, t.healtheval AS health_safety_status, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS average_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.healtheval), group_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM site_groups) SELECT g.site_code, g.health_safety_status, g.average_ratio, g.scan_count, g.average_ratio - m.mean_ratio AS amount_above_mean FROM site_groups AS g CROSS JOIN group_mean AS m WHERE g.average_ratio > m.mean_ratio ORDER BY amount_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
